newsitem.title: USA: Molten Metal buys rest of Tenn. waste plant.
newsitem.headline: Molten Metal buys rest of Tenn. waste plant.

text.p: Molten Metal Technology Inc said Wednesday it has bought the rest of a waste-processing plant it owned jointly with Scientific Ecology Group Inc.
Molten Metal said it paid $31 million cash for Scientific Ecology's half of the Oak Ridge, Tennessee, facility, which was built to process waste from commercial nuclear power plants.
"This acquisition will enable Molten Metal Technology to offer full service to the wet waste side of the important commercial radioactive waste industry," the company said in a release.
Scientific Ecology Group Inc is a subsidiary of Westinghouse Electric Corp.
